findings.evidence: `kostantRootSubgroupMatrix_eq_transvectionUnit` and `map_kostantRootSubgroupParam_eq_transvectionUnit` have LHSs depending on `i,t` but RHSs additionally depending on `{j}` and `hij : i ≠ j`.
findings.fix: State the canonical equations using the determined index `i.rev` and annotate them `[simp]`; derive arbitrary-`j` uses locally after proving `j = i.rev`, without retaining duplicate public theorem names.
findings.issue: Both root-subgroup identification equations (lines 86 and 100) introduce `j` and `hij` only on the right, so they cannot serve as `[simp]` characteristic lemmas.

findings.evidence: All three orient opaque/specialized expressions to explicit rank-one normal forms; the generic `kostantRootSubgroupPoints_tmul` is already `[simp]`, and the new proofs currently require explicit `rw` with these lemmas.
findings.issue: The normal-form lemmas at lines 73, 90, and 127 are unannotated, so `simp` expands through the generic divided-power API instead of reducing the rank-one operator, nilpotency class, and basis action directly.

summary: The rank-one characteristic API is not in a simplifier-usable canonical form, and several new normal-form evaluation lemmas lack automation annotations.
